newsitem.title: USA: Yonkers Financial says plans stock buy back.
newsitem.headline: Yonkers Financial says plans stock buy back.

text.p: Yonkers Financial Corp said Monday it plans to buy back five percent of the outstanding shares of common stock in the open market over a twelve month period.
The company said the shares will be purchased at market price.
The company said it has provided notice of its plans to the office of thrift supervision.
The company said the repurchased shares will become treasury shares.
The company said on March 31, it had consolidated total assets of $284.4 million, stockholders equity of $43.5 million and total shares outstanding of 3,179,750.
